notes.title: Powers! Victory! Discord! ASC Update Fall 2017 - Release 0.9.3.5
notes.content:
[h1]Powers! Victory! Discord![/h1]
Atomic Space Command Update Fall 2017 - Release 0.9.3.5

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147477/1ec899a05b21cddd8c73fc7d2308e7fc112a1cfa.png[/img]

We have a huge deal for you this Fall, Cadets! The Fall 2017 Update brings some big new features that makes Arena gameplay more fun & intense and enables automagical (as long as you have Discord installed) bickering with your friends as you operate your amazing space vessles!

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Discord Integration[/b] - 21 million users can't be wrong! Install Discord and Atomic Space Command will drop you into a VOIP chat with your game automagically.
[*] [b]Commander Powers[/b] - Lebeouf and Moon Mutant X-55 now have awesome powers that operate in-game. LeBeouf's "Super Runaway" power will teleport your ship to safety and the Moon Mutant X-55's "Psychic Terror Zone" scares the bejeezus out of enemy crew nearby!
[*] [b]New Arena Victory Rules[/b] - Now, instead of Spice Points, you need merely destroy all 3 of the enemy's Spice Mines... while protecting your own! First player with zero spice mines is the loser.
[*] [b]Updated Crew Control UI[/b] - You can now see your crew on the World View, and drag-drop them onto exterior ship parts to keep the buffin' going!
[/list]

[h1]BUILD NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*] LeBeouf character model now-in game!
[*] Fixed issue where team colors were not being assigned properly
[*] Increased Planet Shield size
[*] Fixed issue where crew would not hurry based on Alert Level
[*] Save Flight Control Scheme to user preferences
[*] AI Fixes and tuning
[*] Disallow docking on planets that belong to the other team
[/list]

[url=https://discordapp.com/apps]Install Discord![/url]

notes.title: #ATOMICSHOWDOWN Saturday!
notes.content:
Cadets,
Calling all players of Atomic Space Command - Join the #AtomicShowdown where we rally our spaceships and promote friendly competition between Atomic Overlords! We will have a Discord voice chat, award in-game items and developers playing alongside you.

[h1]#ATOMICSHOWDOWN![/h1]
The Rear Admirals have authorized a reward for playing on Saturday November 5th between 12:00 PM and 3:00 PM Pacific Standard Time. Come in and play during that time window to get your free in-game item*! We understand that some players will be streaming live as well on Twitch and YouTube, which is cool for humans.

BlamingTim, TallPockets, and other developers will be joining you all in-game!

Role call below to confirm your intent to LAUNCH into the #ATOMICSHOWDOWN

[h1]RELEASE INFO[/h1]
Atomic Space Command will have a hotfix release before the event with some small items of interest, including:

[list]
[*]LeBeouf update - The decorated veteran Atomic Commander is now in-game in all his muffin-topped glory!
[*]Game Lobby Update - You'll find more details in the game lobby, including correct info about player names, ship names, and ping rating
[*]Add AI ships to a game
[*]Lots of minor fixes for stability and networking
[/list]

See you in the Solar Arenas!

- The ASC Team

*Codes for in-game item will be awarded via Discord direct message to those in Discord chat

notes.title: Release 0.9.2 "DEVIL STAR" Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147477/fde79a29f187488aafca30a5f9b31424019a7523.jpg[/img]

[h1]Atomic Space Command[/h1]
[b]Release 0.9.2 "DEVIL STAR" Halloween Update[/b]

[h1]BUILD NOTES[/h1]
With Atomic Space Command Release 0.9.2 "DEVIL STAR" we bring you some Halloween fun along with our first big update! You'll find scary retro-scifi space stuff mashed up with a bit of occult in the tradition of schlocky 50s horror films like Devil Girl from Mars and This Island, Earth.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147477/92d698bb97597c51d5235d4fb4d727461991e167.jpg[/img]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Commander: MOON MUTANT X-55. This denizen of the Devil Star [*]System 666 will serve you, Overlord, for the right price! You will find its weaponry stats... pleasing.
[*]New Arena: System 666. Five equidistant planets orbit a 5-pointed singularity of terror! 
[*]Stay on Target: HUD targeting and UI improved for blaster turrets (circle reticle), and fixed blaster (square reticle).
[*]Criticals! Blasters cause 3X damage when square-cornered crit indicators are held on target long enough - you will see the reticle corners turn red.
[*]Computerized Minions! AI options added to solar systems for build speed difficulty and number of AI cutters.
[*]Stay on Target Part Deux! Added targeting system keys for closest target and target cycling.
[*]Hellspace! New UI Artwork including Halloween theming.
[*]Have It Your Way! New Settings screen with Display Options, Audio Settings, Input Keyboard Mapping, and Keyboard Default Layout illustration.
[*]Try Not To Die... And Learn! New and updated Tutorial Videos.
[/list]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed camera rotation issues.
[*]Fixed nullref breaking ship.
[*]Fixes for images and pricing in in-game Store.
[*]Many other fixes.
[/list]

Thanks for playing, cadets! Please tell your friends to come on by and check out the game!

- The ASC Team

notes.title: ASC Hotfix Build 0.9.1.13
notes.content:
Hi All,
We've been listening to your feedback, watching playthrough streams and videos, and had a great team meeting this morning to prioritize our work for the next major release! It's gonna be [b]sweet[/b]... more on that later this week.

There were a few urgent issues that we have addressed and are pushing a new build. Please restart Steam before playing ASC to make sure you get the latest!

[h1]BUILD NOTES
ASC Hotfix Build 0.9.1.13[/h1]
[list]
[*]Crew model draggable in Arena now (like they are in Hangar) to assign to a Ship Part instead of dragging via their UI icon
[*]Docking is now hover over dock point for a few seconds instead of click
[*]Better on-rails walkthrough of store for the first time (greying out parts so it is more obvious)
[*]Adding ready Button flashing when ship is ready to go
[*]Fixed Life Support 1x1 from taking up too many slots
[*]Add rollover on match list items
[*]Improving find match window look
[*]Adding a "no games found" if there are no matches in the list
[*]Created new TBDockingBehavior to handle ship docking
   [*] Players now hover over mount points in order to dock
   [*] Removed click to dock functionality
   [*] Limited docking to whomever is in control of the helm
   [*] Added a simple docking progress bar to inform the player that the ship is preparing to dock
[*] Highlight ready button when ship is ready to launch
[*] Disable ai opponent options (not implemented yet)
[*] Added a forum button
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]

As always, please let us know what you think here on Steam and keep those videos & screenshots flowing!

- The ASC Team

notes.title: Atomic Space Command 0.9.11 Early Access Release Notes
notes.content:
Atomic Space Command 0.9.1.11 - Build Notes

... AND WE ARE LIVE!

Welcome to the Atomic Space Command Early Access Build! We are very excited to have you jump into our game and check it out - warts and all. We are just entering Beta with this build and so, while there are may things working, you WILL encounter issues. It is meant to be an Early Access title after all!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147477/a7f9880ed58072f9b8ac0ecf04b54a8468bf3161.jpg[/img]

If you have a moment, please let us know what you think of the game privately via our anonymous (unless you want enter your email) [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeTtH2L8R6ypMU8lt0piYxYhzft6tqyCLcjZ--uttsptdGUPA/viewform]survey[/url].

FEATURES
- Game launches and works on Steam for Windows 7,8,10, Mac and Linux
- Menu Navigation works with some exceptions (new UI partially implemented)
- Tutorial Videos
- Store - buy chassis, ship parts, crew with Silver Atomics earned at the end of Arena and Mission gameplay modes
- Premium Store - buy Golden Atomics and spend to obtain vanity premium Flair ship parts like THE FIST and many kinds of hologram trail generators
- Hangar - build 4 types of ships with dozens of parts, with friends
- Multiple players can join a ship and control external systems like helm, weapons, shields, hacktennae with assignment UA
- Blasters fire bolts that damage other ships and internal components based on hit location
- Missile Turrets fire missiles (limited ammo) that track targets and damage other ships and internal components based on hit location
- Hacking system uses Hacktennae and computers to disable enemy ship systems
- Helm uses three selectable control schemes
- Crew can be assigned to ship parts to boost them
- Crew use oxygen and can die without it, or by being damaged by enemy weapons
- Planets can be docked onto and buildings built on nodes using Ore
- Arena System - PVP arena battle with Spice Atomic victory points. Awards Silver Atomics at completion of match.
- Mission System - PVE mission zone with goals. Will eventually award Silver Atomics at completion of goals.
- Solar System Map showing positions of all arena items
- Keyboard shortcuts with remappability

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26147477/f099acf7c70a6f89d7d93fcaa8f0f87ea4cd5186.jpg[/img]

COMING SOON
- Invite Steam friends to hangars and arenas with improved group status UI
- Halloween Space Horror Themed Event - THE DEVIL STAR
- Player gameplay stats tracking
-Mission System Silver Atomics award
- Expanded Ship Chassis and Parts including ship decals, reskins, weapons, defenses, tech, and more
- Crew looks & costumes
- More Commanders
- More Flair like crew reskins, commander reskins, ship holograms, decals, explosion skins and parts
- Commander Powers system
- Crew advancement system
- More tutorial videos
- Improved targeting cycling, gunning views, and general camera tuning for all views
- Improved System Map look and feel with fog-of-war functions

KNOWN ISSUES
- Crew can't be healed
- Ship hulls can't be repaired
- When gunning it is difficult to keep targets on screen manually (use target lock!)
- On respawn there are sometimes issues like syncronization problems (other entities jitter), reticle text and symbol misplacement, and others
- Sometimes passenger camera is inset inside a planet when docking with a planet
- Networking issues and disconnects sometimes occur when players create, join, and enter arenas
- Sometimes a passenger on a ship won't see ship moving but game continues - to workaround, let passenger take and release helm
- Networking disconnects can occur that cause planets to stop spinning, victory count to stop,
- Input Subsection of the Settings Menu Scrolls Slowly

notes.title: Atomic Space Command Early Access on Sale September 30 for $19.99
notes.content:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

ATOMIC SPACE COMMAND LAUNCHING ON STEAM EARLY ACCESS

Indie co-op spaceship arena action strategy game to be released on September 30th, 2016

SAN FRANCISCO, September 12, 2016 – No, You Shut Up! Games, the game development studio where ninjas point accusatorially at you ALL THE TIME, will self-publish Atomic Space Command on Steam Early Access on September 30th, 2016 for $19.99. The title will be available in English only on PC, Mac and Linux.

Executive Producer Marty Caplan said, “Steam Early Access is the perfect place to publish our next game in its early stage. Atomic Space Command has seven months of solid development behind it now, and it’s time to put it in front of the kind of gamers who can appreciate a work in progress and help us refine it.” The game will include the following features:

[list]
[*]The basic systems are complete for networked players to build a multiplayer ship in a hangar together
[*]A versus Solar Arena with two sides of up to two ships, with each ship having up to four players
[*]Ships have systems like weapons, helm, shields, power and crews that must be managed 
[*]Planets have build points and a selection of installations to build on them 
[*]A basic AI system flies team-aligned fighters and smart mines around the Arena
[*]Single player mode with 6+ completable missions
[*]And much more!
[/list]

Atomic Space Command is everything you ever wanted in a space-ship-building and arena-combat-with-friends game! Build, crew and conquer with co-op multiplayer ships in a solar system arena to become the Atomic Overlord – or at least, try not to die! Atomic Space Command is a humorous, tongue-in-cheek take on a new competitive sci-fi team sport where dozens of players manage planets, route power to weapons, thrusters & shields and fight in fleets made from their collectively built ships. Set for release on Steam Early Access September 30 2016, Atomic Space Command is THE last word in retro-futuristic cooperative spaceship combat.

Check out the Atomic Space Command on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/445350/

ABOUT NO, YOU SHUT UP! INC
No, You Shut Up! Inc. is an independent game development studio based in Albany, CA. Founded by industry veterans from EA/Maxis and BioWare, Sega, Playstudios and many more, the NYSU team brings a ton of talent to original and licensed game development.  We develop competitive space arena titles, action adventure titles, augmented reality / virtual reality games, and everything in between for PC/Mac/Linux, Android and iOS.

Connect with us!
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/atomicspacecommand]https://www.twitch.tv/atomicspacecommand[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/atomicspacecom]https://twitter.com/atomicspacecom[/url]
[url=https://facebook.com/noyoushutupgames/]https://facebook.com/noyoushutupgames/[/url]
[url=https://instagram.com/nysu_games/]https://instagram.com/nysu_games/[/url]
[url=https://reddit.com/r/AtomicSpaceCommand/]https://reddit.com/r/AtomicSpaceCommand/[/url]

For press or business inquiries please contact Marty Caplan, Executive Producer, at Marty@noyoushutupgames.com

[list]
[*]The basic systems are complete for networked players to build a multiplayer ship in a hangar together
[*]A versus Solar Arena with two sides of up to two ships, with each ship having up to four players
[*]Ships have systems like weapons, helm, shields, power and crews that must be managed 
[*]Planets have build points and a selection of installations to build on them 
[*]A basic AI system flies team-aligned fighters and smart mines around the Arena
[*]Single player mode with 6+ completable missions
[*]And much more!
[/list]

Atomic Space Command is everything you ever wanted in a space-ship-building and arena-combat-with-friends game! Build, crew and conquer with co-op multiplayer ships in a solar system arena to become the Atomic Overlord – or at least, try not to die! Atomic Space Command is a humorous, tongue-in-cheek take on a new competitive sci-fi team sport where dozens of players manage planets, route power to weapons, thrusters & shields and fight in fleets made from their collectively built ships. Set for release on Steam Early Access September 30 2016, Atomic Space Command is THE last word in retro-futuristic cooperative spaceship combat.
